item.title: about me
item.content:encoded:
I am arshtyi, an undergraduate student majoring in Computer Science and Technology (Artificial Intelligence) at Shandong University, China.

areas of interest

I enjoy connecting knowledge, technology, and personal interests through programming. My areas of interest include:

  • algorithms and problem solving
  • programming languages and software development
  • formal verification
  • typesetting and technical writing tools

languages and tools

  • programming languages: rust, cpp, zig, c#, go, python, lua, kotlin etc
  • formal verification: lean
  • typesetting: typst

beyond programming

Outside computer science, I am interested in science fiction, trading card games—especially Yu-Gi-Oh!—and strategy games.
